name: HRT_CHANNEL_MESSAGES
description: The table stores the email messages for each channel

columns.name: MESSAGE_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of Channel Messages

columns.name: MESSAGE_FROM
columns.description: Identify the Message Sender Email Address

columns.name: MESSAGE_TO
columns.description: Identify the Receipient Channel, Foreign Key to the Channel

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to Person

columns.name: EMAIL_FROM
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email Sender's Email Address

columns.name: EMAIL_TO
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email Receipient's Email Addressy

columns.name: EMAIL_CC
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email CC Email Address

columns.name: EMAIL_BCC
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email BCC Email Address

columns.name: EMAIL_DATE
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email Date

columns.name: EMAIL_SUBJECT
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email Subject

columns.name: EMAIL_BODY
columns.description: Idenitfy the Original Email Body

columns.name: TAGS
columns.description: Idenitfy the Tags Used for the Message

columns.name: STAR
columns.description: Idenitfy the Star Used in the Original Email

columns.name: HASHTAGS
columns.description: Idenitfy the Hashtags Being Used in the Original Email

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Identify the Status of the Message

columns.name: BUSINESS_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Foreign key to HR_ALL_ORGANIZATION_UNITS

columns.name: SOURCE
columns.description: Identify the Source of the Message

columns.name: ATTACHMENT_EXIST_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if attachment exists for the channel message.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
